svg.title: Research: fine-tuning GPT-2 Medium
svg.desc: Advancing NLP Tasks Through Fine-tuning of Foundation Language Models, 2024, with Md. Jidanul Hakim Jitu. GPT-2 Medium, 355M parameters, fine-tuned on IMDB movie reviews with few labelled examples, adaptive few-shot prompts and an Optuna hyperparameter search. Accuracy 86.7%.
